name: @repo/desktop
description: A personal assistant you talk to.
author: Rodolphe Barbanneau and Tommy Sendra

scripts.package:win: node build/stage.ts --os win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --projectDir stage --config ../build/electron-builder.yml --win zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: node build/stage.ts --os darwin --arch arm64 && electron-builder --projectDir stage --config ../build/electron-builder.yml --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux: node build/stage.ts --os linux --arch x64 && electron-builder --projectDir stage --config ../build/electron-builder.yml --linux --x64 --publish never
